"""Simple job scheduler for periodic ingestion tasks."""

import time
import logging
import traceback
from typing import Any, Callable
from collections.abc import Callable as AbcCallable

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Job:
    def __init__(self, name: str, fn: AbcCallable[..., Any], interval_seconds: float, args: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None, kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.fn = fn
        self.interval = interval_seconds
        self.args = args or ()
        self.kwargs = kwargs or {}
        self.last_run: float = 0
        self.run_count = 0
        self.error_count = 0
        self.last_error: str | None = None
        self.enabled = True

    def is_due(self) -> bool:
        return self.enabled and (time.time() - self.last_run) >= self.interval

    def execute(self) -> Any:
        self.last_run = time.time()
        self.run_count += 1
        try:
            result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            self.error_count += 1
            self.last_error = str(exc)
            logger.error(f"Job '{self.name}' failed: {exc}\n{traceback.format_exc()}")
            return None

    def status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "interval": self.interval,
            "last_run": self.last_run,
            "run_count": self.run_count,
            "error_count": self.error_count,
            "last_error": self.last_error,
            "enabled": self.enabled,
        }


_jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}


def add_job(name: str, fn: AbcCallable[..., Any], interval_seconds: float, args: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None, kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Job:
    """Register a new periodic job."""
    job = Job(name, fn, interval_seconds, args=args, kwargs=kwargs)
    _jobs[name] = job
    return job


def remove_job(name: str) -> Job | None:
    """Unregister a job by name."""
    return _jobs.pop(name, None)


def get_job(name: str) -> Job | None:
    """Look up a job by name."""
    return _jobs.get(name)


def list_jobs() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return status dicts for all registered jobs."""
    return [job.status() for job in _jobs.values()]


def run_pending() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute all jobs that are due."""
    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, job in _jobs.items():
        if job.is_due():
            logger.info(f"Running job: {name}")
            result = job.execute()
            results[name] = result
    return results


def run_loop(check_interval: float = 1.0, max_iterations: int | None = None) -> None:
    """Main scheduler loop. Runs pending jobs on each tick."""
    iteration = 0
    while max_iterations is None or iteration < max_iterations:
        results = run_pending()
        if results:
            logger.debug(f"Tick {iteration}: ran {len(results)} job(s)")
        time.sleep(check_interval)
        iteration += 1


def clear_all() -> None:
    """Remove all registered jobs."""
    _jobs.clear()


def disable_job(name: str) -> None:
    """Disable a job without removing it."""
    job = _jobs.get(name)
    if job:
        job.enabled = False


def enable_job(name: str) -> None:
    """Enable a previously disabled job."""
    job = _jobs.get(name)
    if job:
        job.enabled = True

        return self.enabled and (time.time() - self.last_run) >= self.interval

    def execute(self) -> Any:
        self.last_run = time.time()
        self.run_count += 1
        try:
            result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            self.error_count += 1
            self.last_error = str(exc)
            logger.error(f"Job '{self.name}' failed: {exc}\n{traceback.format_exc()}")
            return None

    def status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "interval": self.interval,
            "last_run": self.last_run,
            "run_count": self.run_count,
            "error_count": self.error_count,
            "last_error": self.last_error,
            "enabled": self.enabled,
        }

def add_job(name: str, fn: AbcCallable[..., Any], interval_seconds: float, args: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None, kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Job:

    return _jobs.pop(name, None)


def get_job(name: str) -> Job | None:
    """Look up a job by name."""
    return _jobs.get(name)


def list_jobs() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return status dicts for all registered jobs."""
    return [job.status() for job in _jobs.values()]


def run_pending() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute all jobs that are due."""
    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, job in _jobs.items():

def run_loop(check_interval: float = 1.0, max_iterations: int | None = None) -> None:
    """Main scheduler loop. Runs pending jobs on each tick."""
    iteration = 0
